item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Chryslaos #8356 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Chryslaos has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.

item.description: Hippnikos #7087 swore by the Styx to repay Archias #1180 the Blood-handed in blood. They have stopped eating with the family.

item.title: Archias #1180 the Blood-handed took refuge at the altar and clasped Hippnikos #7087's knee
item.description: Archias #1180 the Blood-handed took refuge at the altar and clasped Hippnikos #7087's knees there. Hippnikos #7087 refused them at the god's own table. The stain of it is on Hippnikos #7087 now. Archias is the cruel now.
